mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_coupon (coupon_id, user_id, status, redeem_code, redeemed_at, redeemed_by_store_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{couponId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{redeemCode}, #{redeemedAt}, #{redeemedByStoreId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_coupon SET status='REDEEMED', redeemed_at=#{redeemedAt}, redeemed_by_store_id=#{redeemedByStoreId}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='AVAILABLE'
mapper.select: SELECT id, coupon_id, user_id, status, redeem_code, redeemed_at, redeemed_by_store_id, created_at, updated_at FROM user_coupon WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT id, coupon_id, user_id, status, redeem_code, redeemed_at, redeemed_by_store_id, created_at, updated_at FROM user_coupon WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND coupon_id=#{couponId}
SELECT id, coupon_id, user_id, status, redeem_code, redeemed_at, redeemed_by_store_id, created_at, updated_at FROM user_coupon WHERE redeem_code=#{redeemCode}
